description_en: Configures the owner of an instance, a database, or a table
name: SetOwners

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource. The ID of the resource varies with the owner type. The owner types and resource IDs have the following mappings:

INSTANCE: the ID of an instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html operation to query the ID of the instance.
DATABASE: the ID of a physical database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to query the ID of the physical database.
LOGIC_DATABASE: the ID of a logical database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to query the ID of the logical database.
TABLE: the ID of a physical table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the ID of the physical table.
LOGIC_DATABASE: the ID of a logical table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html operation to query the ID of the logical table
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。不同的Owner类型会指向不同的资源ID，Owner类型与资源ID的对应关系如下：
INSTANCE：实例的InstanceId，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html获取该参数的值。
DATABASE： 物理库的DatabaseId，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html获取该参数的值。
LOGIC_DATABASE：逻辑库的DatabaseId，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取该参数的值。
TABLE：物理表的TableId，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html获取该参数的值。
LOGIC_TABLE：逻辑表的TableId，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141875.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the owner. Valid values:

INSTANCE: an owner of an instance.
DATABASE: an owner of a physical database.
LOGIC_DATABASE: an owner of a logical database.
TABLE: an owner of a physical table.
LOGIC_TABLE: an owner of a logical table
parameters.help_zh:
Owner类型，取值如下：
INSTANCE：实例Owner
DATABASE：物理库Owner
LOGIC_DATABASE：逻辑库Owner
TABLE：物理表Owner
LOGIC_TABLE：逻辑表Owner
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user whom you want to specify as an owner. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to query the ID of the user.

The value of the OwnerIds parameter is that of the UserId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Owner的用户ID，多个用户ID用逗号分开。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取UserId的值。
用户ID的参数名为UserId
parameters.name: owner_ids

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
